purpose: Teach: 高音/逸話/吸引/教区/脱皮/表層/平原/氷河

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、声帯の高音発声異常を医療チームで評価します
lines.en: Ren, we'll have the medical team evaluate your vocal cords for any high-frequency irregularities.
lines.style: Clear and measured. Steady eye contact. Professional but not distant. Slight pause before the medical detail, giving him space to absorb.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の逸話的症状を医療チームで丁寧に聞きます
lines.en: Yes, we listen carefully to what patients tell us about their symptoms—that's how the team learns what's actually happening.
lines.style: Warm professionalism. Lean slightly forward on 'listen'. Unhurried pace. The tone of someone who has learned that anecdotes matter as much as charts.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、痰の吸引処置を医療チームで日々おこないます
lines.en: Ren, we do airway clearance procedures regularly—the medical team handles them as part of your daily care.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. No softening, no dramatizing. Steady tempo. The competence of stating what is routine, and therefore manageable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療圏内、つまり教区的概念を、貴院、参考にされてますね、先生
lines.en: So you work within what we'd call a medical catchment area—your hospital follows that regional framework, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly formal. The careful speech of someone working through an idea aloud. Respectful but genuinely curious. Not asking permission, asking for confirmation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、心理的脱皮を促す療法を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Yes, the medical team provides therapies designed to help with the psychological adjustment that comes with treatment.
lines.style: Patient and clear. Slight emphasis on 'adjustment' — not minimizing what he's going through. Professional warmth, not clinical distance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 表層皮膚の処置を、貴院、丁寧にされてますね、先生
lines.en: I notice your hospital takes real care with the surface-level treatments too—you do them thoroughly.
lines.style: Quiet observation, not quite a compliment but close. Careful word choice. The tone of someone noticing details others miss and choosing to acknowledge it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、平原地域の医療巡回を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, the team covers medical rounds in rural areas too—that's part of what we do.
lines.style: Simple statement of fact. Steady pace. Quiet pride in scope of work, but not boastful. The professionalism of someone whose reach is wider than people realize.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、氷河の寒冷地遠征隊の医療支援も医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we also provide medical support for expeditions in cold regions—glacier work, remote locations. The team handles that as well.
lines.style: Calm enumeration. Slight drop in energy on 'also'—matter-of-fact about the broader scope. Close, intimate delivery: she's clarifying something specific for him.
